title: NtfyAlerts
description: Send notifications to your PC and phone for every Bukkit event you want!
body: # NtfyAlerts [![servers][1]][6] [![modrinth-downloads][5]][8] > Send notifications to your PC and phone for every Bukkit event you want! ## Features - Pick **any**(!) Bukkit event, to send an alert when dispatched - Send to multiple different servers and topics - Customize the alert with a custom title, message, emojis and priority - Send alerts to authorized-only topics - Plugin checks for validity of given servers before sending any alerts ## Usage - Read the `config.yml` (generated upon first startup) and create your alerts! - Don't know what Ntfy is? Check out their [website][14]! Example: ```yaml events: - event: "org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerJoinEvent" topic: "my-cool-topic-12345" server: "https://your-ntfy-server.de" title: "My cool alert" message: "${player} has joined the server!" tags: - "heavy_plus_sign" - "green_square" priority: "3" auth: username: "your-user" password: "your-pw" ``` ## Questions or feedback? - Create an issue [here][11] ## See also - [MultiTime][9] - [MultiWeather][10] - [MultiChat][13] Note: This plugin is not affiliated with ntfy.sh [1]: https://img.shields.io/bstats/servers/28207 [5]: https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/qOukg4ox?label=modrinth%20downloads&color=%231bd96a [6]: https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/NtfyAlerts/28207 [8]: https://modrinth.com/project/ntfyalerts [9]: https://modrinth.com/plugin/multitime [10]: https://modrinth.com/plugin/multiweather [11]: https://codeberg.org/MaddinM/NtfyAlerts/issues [13]: https://modrinth.com/plugin/multichat2 [14]: https://ntfy.sh/
